meta.title: Tech+RFQ: RFQ stage before the technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its technical round without creating or changing the event.
Continue in Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session open.
Open the event in the vendor portal on the technical stage, before answering it.
Assert that the commercial RFQ stage is locked before the technical response is submitted.
Try to enter the RFQ stage and require the portal to refuse the navigation or otherwise show refusal evidence.
